lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A tour audition notice sits beside Miku's open notebook. The chorus on the page has been crossed out twice.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Hmm. Nope. Still doesn't sound right.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Maybe if I move the chorus up...

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Her phone buzzes with another reminder about the auditions.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: I know, I know! I'm entering!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: ...Just as soon as I figure out what I'm singing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The final audition results name Miku as headliner. Her notebook is open to a finished song.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: So, what's the first song?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: I was hoping we could all do it together.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: All six of us? You could've asked first!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: I'm asking now!

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: You already wrote the parts, didn't you?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: ...Maybe a few.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She turns the notebook around. Six names are written beside the first verse.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len is checking the sound on the rooftop stage. A KAITO concert ticket sticks out of his notebook.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: You've got that ticket with you again?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: It's good luck!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Does it work for auditions?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Guess we're about to find out.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Hey, save some luck for me!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len keeps humming a phrase as he unplugs his microphone.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Was that in your song? I don't remember it.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Made it up just now.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Can you sing it again? I liked it!

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Sure. But I'm writing it down first.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Fair. It's already stuck in my head.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin is testing the speakers at the old tram depot. The bass rattles the railing.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Miku! You're up next. Hope you brought something good!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: I did. Mostly.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Mostly?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: I'm still deciding on the ending.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Then you'd better decide fast. I'm not going easy on you!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The crowd starts clapping the rhythm from Miku's final chorus. Rin joins in before noticing.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Ah! You're doing it too!

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: It's stuck in my head. That's not a compliment.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Then why are you still clapping?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Next time, I'm bringing a chorus you can't get rid of.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: I'll look forward to it!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO is waving at the camera set up by the harbor stage. Its indicator light is still off.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: KAITO, you're not live yet.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Ah. That explains why nobody's waving back.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: You could wave at the people right in front of you.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: You're right! Hello, everyone!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Haha! Save some energy for our match!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The broadcast ends, but someone beyond the harbor fence is still singing KAITO's chorus.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Oh! He stayed for the whole show.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: And he's singing your chorus! I worked hard on mine, too.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Want to try yours together?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Sure. Let's give him another song to take home.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: MEIKO pins a full set list over a poster advertising fifteen-second song previews.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Are the previews really only fifteen seconds?

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: That's what the organizers asked for.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: That's barely enough for my intro!

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Then maybe the intro needs some editing.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Hey! I worked hard on it!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The applause is still going when Miku returns to the side of the stage.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: I thought that quiet part was going to lose them.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: You looked ready to skip it.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: I almost did.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Glad you didn't. It was my favorite part.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Really? ...Okay, that one's staying.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Luka is comparing three lyric sheets under the planetarium's projected stars.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Three versions? Which one are you using?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I haven't decided yet.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Oh, good. My own ending's still a mess.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: You don't seem especially worried.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Ask me again when we're onstage!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A folded note beside Luka's music stand reads: 'For whoever sings it next.'

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Is that from whoever wrote your song?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I wish I knew.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: They could've signed it, at least.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: There isn't much else to go on.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Well, I hope they get to hear you sing it!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len replays an old KAITO concert for the third time today.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Watching it again?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Shh. This is the best part.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: You say that about every song. What are you singing at the auditions?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: ...Still working on it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len's name tops the tour poster. In his notebook is an old KAITO concert ticket, covered in notes on the back.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Ready for opening night?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Yeah. I've got the first song picked out.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Oh? Which one?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Mine. Lights Left On. You'll sing the second verse, right?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: If you teach it to me!

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Just try to keep up.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len laughs and heads toward the stage, with KAITO following him.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Miku catches Len practicing KAITO's chorus near the courtyard stage.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Isn't that KAITO's song?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: You recognized it that fast?!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: You've been humming it all morning.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: It's a warm-up. I've got my own song too!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Then let's hear it!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: People near the food stalls are humming a melody from Len's winning performance.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Hear that? They're singing your chorus!

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Wait. My chorus?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: It's catchy. I nearly joined in myself.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Then next time, you should.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Deal! You'll have to teach me the words.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin stops rehearsing when Len changes the rhythm without warning.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Hey! That's not the count!

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: It is now.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: You could've warned me!

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: What, can't keep up?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Just watch me.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin is still tapping the rhythm Len used in their final round.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: That pause was so annoying.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: You liked it.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: I did not!

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: You're tapping it right now.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: So I can beat it next time!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO notices an old concert ticket sticking out of Len's notebook.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: You were at that show? The wind took my set list halfway through!

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Wait. That long pause wasn't planned?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: I was waiting for someone to bring it back.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I thought you were building suspense!

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: ...Can we keep that between us?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len checks the results twice. KAITO holds out his hand.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I really won? You didn't go easy on me?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Not a bit. That last chorus almost got away from me.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I used to practice your songs every day.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Then it's about time I practiced one of yours.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Heh. I've got a new one for you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len finishes rehearsing a high note. MEIKO looks up from her set list.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Nice note. What happened to the verse before it?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I cut it. It's about missing the last train. Not exactly exciting.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Hah. KAITO and I did that once.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Really? What happened?

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Long story. Sing me that verse first.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len keeps the verse about missing the train in his winning performance.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I thought everyone would get bored during that part.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Did you see the guy in the front row? He laughed at the last line.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Really? I nearly cut the whole verse.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Good thing you didn't.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I'm keeping the high note too, just saying.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Luka plays an unsigned melody. Len stops to listen.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Huh. Never heard this one. Who's it by?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: That's what I'm trying to find out.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Really? You don't know?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I know how it goes. That's a start.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Play the chorus again? I like that bit.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Luka listens as Len stops halfway through a melody of his own.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: You changed the ending.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Twice. Neither version sounds right.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Try ending it a beat earlier.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Won't it sound unfinished?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Play it once and see.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin pins the audition invitation to an amp and starts circling names.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: You circled my name twice.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Making sure you don't chicken out.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I'm entering. And I'm going to beat you.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: You've been saying that all week.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Just giving you time to prepare!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The final results name Rin as headliner. She folds her marked-up audition invitation.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: You won. Can you stop looking so smug now?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Nope.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: So what are you doing with the headline spot?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Putting everyone on the opening-night set list.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Even me?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Especially you. I still want that rematch.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len writes REMATCH on the back of her invitation. Rin grins.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: People waiting for food are singing along as Miku checks her microphone.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Did you start without me?!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: It's just a sound check!

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Tell that to your fan club over there.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: They know the chorus. Want to give them a new one?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Gladly. Hope you can keep up!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin wins, but the crowd keeps singing the chorus with the wrong words.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: That's not even close to the lyrics!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: I think they're singing about noodles.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: ...Okay, that does fit the rhythm.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: See? It's catchy!

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Don't encourage them. I'm gonna start singing it too.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len is rehearsing an ending Rin hasn't heard before.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Hold on. Since when do you sing it like that?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Since yesterday.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Yesterday?! We practiced this all week!

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Worried?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: About you? Never. About your timing? Constantly.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin wins, but Len is still humming the new ending he tried in the final round.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I almost had you with that last bit.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Almost. I heard you coming a mile away.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Then I'll change it again.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Go ahead. I'll come up with something new, too.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: You never let me have anything, do you?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO adjusts a microphone while the harbor broadcast camera gets into position.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: KAITO! Bet I get the louder cheer!

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: You might want to test your microphone first.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Already did!

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: It's switched off.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: ...That was a practice cheer.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin strikes a victory pose at the camera just as its red light clicks off.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Hey! I wasn't finished!

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: The broadcast was.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Did anybody see that?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: That gentleman by the fence did.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A dockworker copies her pose. Rin bursts out laughing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin is drumming on a seat back while MEIKO checks the set list.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Could you give that poor seat a break?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: There's nobody here! It's too quiet.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: The doors don't open for another ten minutes.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: ...Right. Well, they'll hear me when they get here.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: I'm counting on it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin wins with a slower song than usual and drops into a seat beside MEIKO.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: I thought I was going to speed up in that last verse.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Your foot definitely wanted to.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: But I didn't!

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Nope. You kept it steady.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Don't sound so surprised!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Luka has three versions of the same song spread across a bench.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Is that homework? You look like you're grading papers.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I'm trying to decide which verse to sing.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Pick the one you like best.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: And if I change my mind halfway through?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Then change the verse. You can do that!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin forgets a lyric, makes up another one, and still wins.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Since when did that song mention the last tram?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Since I forgot what came next.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: It actually suited the melody.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Great! Then I meant to do it.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Of course you did.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO's phone plays the same chorus again. Miku looks over from her seat.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Still watching that clip?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: It's past a hundred thousand views!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: That's great! Does anyone know the next verse?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Not yet. I'm entering the auditions to fix that.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Then you'd better get rehearsing!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO has won the headline spot. Backstage, he's trying to squeeze the words NEXT SHOW onto a small sign.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: You're still making that sign?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Of course! People keep asking where they can hear the full song.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Aren't they about to hear it right now?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: That's tonight. I'm thinking about the next concert!

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Haha! One show at a time, KAITO.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO laughs, sets the sign by the entrance, and hurries onstage as the audience calls his name.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Someone in the food queue is singing KAITO's famous chorus. Unfortunately, they've got the lyrics wrong.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: That's not quite how it goes...

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: They're having fun!

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: I know, I know. It's just—there's a whole second verse!

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Then sing it! I'm curious too.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: You haven't heard it either?!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO wins. A few people near the stalls call for the second verse again.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Wait, you want that part?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: They were singing along by the end!

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: I spent ages writing those lyrics, you know.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: And now you've got backup singers. Very enthusiastic ones.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Haha! All right, one more time!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len pulls a worn concert ticket from his notebook as KAITO walks up.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: KAITO! Could you sign this?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Of course! Oh, that show—the wind took my set list.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: So that long pause wasn't planned?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: I was waiting for someone to bring it back.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I thought it was dramatic!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After KAITO's win, Len hands him a demo with a handwritten track list.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I made you a recording. It's a bit rough.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: A song of your own? I'd love to hear it.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Just ignore the second verse. I'm fixing it.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Now I'm curious about the second verse.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: KAITO!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin leans over KAITO's shoulder while he reads comments on his phone.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Still checking those numbers?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Just seeing what people think.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Then here's my review: you're taking forever to start.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: That's a little harsh, don't you think?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Want a better review? Beat me first!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO wins, but the crowd immediately starts chanting for another song.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Hah! Looks like you're not getting off that easily.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: I hadn't planned an encore.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Seriously? You've got all these people right here!

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Well, do you know the harmony?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Obviously. Move over!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO studies a promotional message on his phone. MEIKO glances at his expression.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Bad news?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: They want another fifteen-second clip. The exact same chorus.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Well, are you going to give them one?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: I was hoping to sing the whole thing for once.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Then put the phone down. You've got a stage right there.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO comes backstage after singing the whole song, still out of breath.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: They stayed! Even for the quiet verse.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Good. You looked pretty happy up there.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: I was! Do you think they'd want an encore?

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Probably. But have some water first.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Okay. Then an encore!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO has his phone out, ready to share a clip of Luka rehearsing.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: That sounded lovely. Mind if I post it?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Not yet. I still don't know who wrote the song.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Oh. I was about to credit you.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Which would make things rather awkward if the writer saw it.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Right. Good thing I asked first!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO shows Luka a draft post asking who wrote her unsigned melody.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: I included the opening notes. What do you think?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Much better. But please change that photo.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: You look very thoughtful.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: KAITO. My eyes are closed.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: ...I'll change it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO holds up the proposed tour promo. Almost every part of MEIKO's song is crossed out except the chorus.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Good news! They love your chorus.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: And the rest of the song apparently offended them.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: It's a fifteen-second preview.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: I know. I'm not putting on a fifteen-second concert, though.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She takes out a red pencil and circles the full set list.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: MEIKO's name tops the tour poster. She checks the full opening set list while KAITO holds up his phone.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: The new preview's doing well. They're asking when the full version comes out.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Tonight, if everyone gets onstage on time.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: So... should I post the whole song afterward?

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Sure. First, let's give them a show worth recording.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She tucks the red pencil behind her ear and heads toward the stage as the house lights dim.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: MEIKO rehearses an introduction. She stops halfway through and scratches out three lines.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Wait, I liked that part!

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: The part where I explain the song before singing it?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: ...When you put it like that.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: You can tell me if you miss it after the show.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Deal! But I'm keeping my own introduction.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The crowd is still cheering after MEIKO's win. Miku picks up the discarded introduction sheet.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Okay, I didn't miss it.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Should I frame that sentence?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Don't get too excited. I have notes about the second verse.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Now you're talking. Let's hear them.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: First, can I borrow that pencil?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len tries the same high note for the fourth time. MEIKO sets a bottle of water beside him.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: I can hit it. I just need one more try.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: That's what you said three tries ago.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: You've never had trouble with a note?

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Ask KAITO about my first live show. Actually, don't.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Now I definitely have to ask him.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: MEIKO wins despite a brief crack on one high note. Len meets her backstage.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: You missed that note.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: I noticed.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: But you kept going.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: The rest of the song wasn't going to sing itself.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Hah. Fair point.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin claps a fast beat while MEIKO adjusts her microphone.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Come on! This place needs something LOUD!

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: It was loud before you got here.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: That's a compliment, right?

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Sure. Let's see if you can make it through the slow part without speeding up.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Oh, it's a challenge now?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A few people call for MEIKO's quiet opening verse again. Rin looks offended on principle.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Seriously? They want the slow bit?

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: You could sing it with me.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: At that speed? I'll fall asleep!

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Then I'll wake you when it's your turn.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: ...Fine. But next time, we do my version too.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO plays MEIKO a proposed fifteen-second promo clip on his phone.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: This is the version the organizers want to post.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: It cuts off in the middle of my sentence.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Technically, the middle of your verse.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Thank you, that's much better.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: ...I'll take that as a no.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO shows MEIKO a recording of the audience leaning forward before her quiet verse.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Look. They all leaned in right here.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: That's where we should end the preview.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Right before the verse? That's cruel.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: They can hear the rest at the show.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: ...I see what you're doing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Luka shows MEIKO two lyric sheets with the same melody and different words.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I can't choose which verse to sing.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Why not use both?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: One asks someone to stay. The other tells them to go.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Try them in a different order. See how they sound together.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I'll give it a try.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After MEIKO's win, Luka shows her an updated arrangement backstage.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I tried both verses, like you suggested.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: How'd they sound?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Better. I kept the pause before the second one.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Then keep it. It's your arrangement.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I think I will.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Luka has three copies of the same tune spread across the train seat beside her. Her audition map is open on her lap.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: "Come home"... "Keep going"... and "Wait for me."

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She hums the melody. It's the one she heard someone singing backstage years ago.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I still remember it. I wish I'd asked who was singing.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: She checks the pages again. None of them names a writer.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Maybe someone at the auditions will recognize it.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Luka's name tops the tour poster. Backstage, an envelope on a lighting case is signed 'Aya — touring electrician.'

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: So it was you.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Aya writes that she made up the melody to keep her crew awake on long drives. The crews who came after her added their own verses.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I heard one of them singing it years ago.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Below her signature, Aya adds: 'Please tell me they cut the verse about my driving.'

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Sorry, Aya. I think that one's staying.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Onstage, Luka credits Aya and the touring crews before singing. She leaves the last line for whoever picks it up next.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Luka hears Miku humming the familiar melody while she sets up her microphone.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Miku. Where did you hear that?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Hm? Oh! Someone sang it here last week. It's been stuck in my head.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: What came after the chorus?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Uh... I made up that part.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Of course you did.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A stagehand hands Miku a folded note while the crowd is leaving.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Hey, Luka! I think this one's for you.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: "For whoever sings it next." That's all?

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Wait, there's a drawing on the back. Is that... a ladder?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: A lighting rig, I think.

lines.speaker: Miku
lines.text: Oh! So maybe ask the crew instead of the singers?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Len flips through souvenirs from his first KAITO concert. A few notes are scribbled on the back of a program.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Wait. I know that melody. Did you write those notes?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Yeah. I heard someone humming while I waited for the doors to open.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Someone from the audience?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: No, it came from inside. One of the crew, I think.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Could I take a closer look?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: After Luka's win, Len turns the program over. A pencil note reads: LIGHT CHECK.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Oh, right. They were testing the lights before the show.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: So it wasn't part of KAITO's set.

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Nope. I could hear it while I waited outside.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Mind if I take a picture of this?

lines.speaker: Len
lines.text: Sure. I'm keeping the original, though!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Two workers are tapping a rhythm against a tram. Rin has joined in—loudly.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: That rhythm. Do you know the song that goes with it?

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: There's a song? They taught me the beat five minutes ago.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: The version I heard was rather slow.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Then your version needs help. C'mon, listen to this!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Rin speeds up. One of the workers almost drops his wrench.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: A depot worker passes Rin a creased lyric sheet.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Here! Apparently the old touring crew used to sing it on night shifts.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: This verse is about terrible coffee.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: Best verse so far, if you ask me.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: I suppose someone had to write it.

lines.speaker: Rin
lines.text: And now I'm going to sing it. You can complain after!

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: KAITO is warming up for a broadcast rehearsal. Luka stops when he sings a familiar line.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: KAITO, where did you learn that verse?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: A technician was singing it during a sound check.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Do you remember who?

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: I remember thanking her. Not asking her name.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: That's a shame.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: The broadcast camera is still on after Luka's win. KAITO points to it.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: Want to ask about the song while we're live?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: If you know who first wrote this melody, please leave a message with the tour crew.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: I'll make sure the clip stays up afterward.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Thanks, KAITO.

lines.speaker: KAITO
lines.text: And I'll check the credits this time.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Luka hums the melody for MEIKO, who pulls an old rehearsal book from the cabinet behind the screen.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: Is this the tune you've been looking for?

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: That's it. You know it?

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: The crews sang it while packing up. Every city had a new verse.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Do you know who started it?

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: No. But look at all these different handwritings.

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: MEIKO opens the book to a page covered in several hands.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: Someone crossed out the second verse.

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: The next crew wrote a new one under it.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: And that empty line at the end?

lines.speaker: MEIKO
lines.text: They always left it for the next person.

lines.speaker: Luka
lines.text: So it was meant to keep changing.
